# Configuration reference

Every key of `jezero.toml`, generated from the configuration models. A complete,
commented example lives in [`jezero.example.toml`](../../jezero.example.toml).

Jezero reads the file given with `--config`, else `$JEZERO_CONFIG`, else
`./jezero.toml`, and loads a `.env` file next to it (variables already set win).
Relative paths are relative to the file. Unknown keys are an error, so a typo never
goes unnoticed.

> [!NOTE]
> Secrets never go in this file. Keys ending in `_env` hold the *name* of an
> environment variable, and an option that looks like a secret without `_env` is
> rejected.

| Table | |
|---|---|
| [`[storage]`](#storage) | Where the library lives. |
| [`[search]`](#search) | How results are ranked and how many come back. |
| [`[summarizer]`](#summarizer) | The model that writes each item. |
| [`[server]`](#server) | The MCP server and its HTTP routes. |
| [`[[clients]]`](#clients) | Who may read (and upload). One block per key. |
| [`[[connectors]]`](#connectors) | Where items come from. One block per source. |
| [`[inbox]`](#inbox) | Where uploaded sessions land. |

## storage

Where the library lives.

```toml
[storage]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | `"data/jezero.db"` | The SQLite file (created by `jezero init`). Relative to the config file. |
| `tokenizer` | string | `"trigram remove_diacritics 1"` | FTS5 tokenizer. The default matches plurals as substrings and ignores accents. |

## search

How results are ranked and how many come back.

```toml
[search]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `default_limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100) | `10` | Results returned when a caller does not ask for a number. |
| `max_limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 500) | `50` | Most results any single call may return, whatever it asks for. |
| `candidate_pool` | integer (≥ 10, ≤ 5000) | `200` | How many BM25 candidates are re-ranked by recency. |
| `recency_half_life_days` | number (> 0) | `90.0` | Age at which the recency boost of an item is half that of a new one. |
| `recency_weight` | number (≥ 0.0, ≤ 1.0) | `0.3` | 0 = pure BM25, 1 = relevance fully scaled by recency. |

## summarizer

The model that writes each item.

```toml
[summarizer]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `"anthropic"` \| `"openai_compatible"` | `"anthropic"` | API dialect: Anthropic Messages, or any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. |
| `base_url` | string | `"https://api.anthropic.com"` | Endpoint of the provider (for example a local OpenAI-compatible server). |
| `model` | string (optional) | none | Use a cheap, fast model. Required before running any connector. |
| `api_key_env` | string | `"JEZERO_SUMMARIZER_API_KEY"` | Environment variable holding the provider's API key. |
| `max_concurrency` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 64) | `4` | Summaries requested in parallel. |
| `timeout_seconds` | number (> 0) | `120.0` | Time allowed for one summary request. |
| `max_input_chars` | integer (≥ 1000) | `60000` | Longer inputs are split into parts, each summarised on its own. |
| `known_projects` | list of string | empty | Project slugs the summarizer should prefer when tagging items. |
| `output_language` | string (optional) | none | Write every summary in this language (e.g. "Spanish") so one query matches all items. Default: the document's main language. |
| `allow_insecure_http` | boolean | `false` | Accept an `http://` base_url on a host that is not loopback. Off by default: the API key would travel in clear. Turn on only for a private network you trust. |

## server

The MCP server and its HTTP routes.

```toml
[server]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` | Address to listen on. Keep loopback and publish through a reverse proxy. |
| `port` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 65535) | `8765` | Port to listen on. |
| `path` | string | `"/mcp"` | URL path of the MCP endpoint. |
| `public_url` | string (optional) | none | External URL when served behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://library.example.org/mcp |
| `allowed_hosts` | list of string | empty | Extra Host header values accepted (DNS-rebinding protection). Derived from public_url. |
| `require_auth` | boolean | `true` | Ask every request for a client key. May be turned off only on a loopback host, and never together with public_url or allowed_hosts. |
| `client_bundle` | path (optional) | `"dist/jezero-client.tar.gz"` | Plugin bundle offered at /client/jezero-client.tar.gz (public code, no auth). |

## clients

Who may read (and upload). One block per key.

An agent (or person) allowed to query the library over MCP.

```toml
[[clients]]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Unique name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (a device's name for plugins). |
| `token_env` | string (optional) | none | Environment variable holding the client's bearer token. |
| `token_sha256` | string (optional) | none | Or: the SHA-256 hex digest of the token (`jezero new-token` prints one). |
| `sources` | list of string | `['*']` | Source names (glob patterns) this client may read. Default: everything. |
| `upload` | boolean | `false` | May deliver raw session files to the inbox (a device running the Jezero plugins). |

## connectors

Where items come from. One block per source.

One configured source. `type` selects the implementation, `name` identifies it.

```toml
[[connectors]]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Unique name, which becomes the `source` of its items (`agent-codex-laptop`). |
| `type` | string | required | Connector type: see the connectors reference. |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Disabled connectors keep their cursor and are skipped by `jezero run`. |
| `interval_minutes` | integer (≥ 1) | `15` | How often `jezero run --due` runs it. |
| `project` | string (optional) | none | Default project for items from this source, when the connector cannot infer one. |
| `trust` | `"own"` \| `"external"` (optional) | none | `own` for your agents' work; `external` for text written by others (mail). Default: the connector type's own default (`external` for gmail, `own` otherwise). |
| `options` | table of any | empty | Type-specific settings (paths, filters). Secrets go through *_env keys only. |

## inbox

Where uploaded sessions land.

Where devices deliver raw session files (see `jezero.inbox`).

```toml
[inbox]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | path | `"data/inbox"` | Folder for uploads, one subfolder per device. Relative to the config file. |
| `max_mb` | number (> 0) | `64.0` | Largest accepted file, after decompression (a `.zst` file is checked decompressed). |
| `max_device_mb` | number (optional) (> 0) | none | Most space one device's inbox folder may use; uploads beyond it get 507. Default: no limit. |

## projects

How a session's folder maps to a project.

How a session's folder maps to a project (see `jezero.projects`).

```toml
[projects]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | table of string | empty | Folder -> project; `~` matches any home folder. Wins over everything else. |
| `roots` | list of string (optional) | none | Folder names that hold projects; default: projects, code, dev, src, repos, ... |
| `aliases` | table of string | empty | Rename a detected project (`"atlas-wt" = "atlas"`). |
| `git` | boolean | `true` | Use the git repository's name when the folder exists on this computer. |

## redaction

What is removed before anything is stored.

```toml
[redaction]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Redact known secret formats (keys, tokens, passwords) before storing anything. |
| `extra_patterns` | list of string | empty | Additional regular expressions to redact before summarising and indexing. |

## watchdog

When `jezero health` raises an alarm.

```toml
[watchdog]
```

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_silence_hours` | number (> 0) | `24.0` | Alert when an enabled connector has not succeeded for this long. |
| `alert_webhook_env` | string (optional) | none | Env var holding a webhook URL that receives a JSON alert. |
| `realert_hours` | number (> 0) | `12.0` | Repeat an alert for the same connector at most this often. |
| `heartbeat_url_env` | string (optional) | none | Env var holding a push URL (for example an Uptime Kuma push monitor). Every health check calls it with status=up or status=down, so silence itself becomes an alert. |
